performance.verdict: Organic-only account; paid is dark, organic signals mixed.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads are fully dark; CPL is undefined and unmeasurable.
GBP actions spiked to 29 in 28 days with a 150% 7d rise, but the last 7 series days show 0 actions — the spike was Aug 25 (11 actions) and is now fading.
Search clicks fell 41.67% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 8–10) average 0.67 clicks vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7) average 1.33 — a confirmed downward 3-day signal.
GA4 sessions fell 41.27% week-over-week; last 3 days average 6.0 vs prior 3 days average 6.7 — modest but consistent with the search click drop.
GBP call rate is 0.0061 per impression (2 calls from 329 impressions) — profile visibility is growing but intent-to-contact conversion is extremely low.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions daily; if 0 actions persists through Sep 14, the Aug 25 spike was an anomaly requiring investigation.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP hit 11 actions on Aug 25 but has logged 0 actions across the last 7 days of the series (Sep 4–10). No paid activity is live to attribute this to. Check GBP posting cadence and any local listing changes made around Aug 25. If actions remain at 0 through Sep 14, escalate to Sohib for profile audit.

suggestions.text: Watch search clicks through Sep 14; 3-day average of 0.67 vs 1.33 prior — confirm if structural or transient before any SEO action.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks are down 41.67% week-over-week and the 3-day signal (Sep 8–10 avg 0.67 clicks) confirms the direction. GA4 sessions are also down 41.27%. No paid media is running to explain a traffic source switch. Re-check on Sep 14 — if clicks remain below 1/day average, surface to Sohib for organic/SEO review.

suggestions.text: Flag paid channel dark status to Sohib: $0 spend for 28+ days on a leadgen client requires explicit confirmation this is intentional.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have recorded $0 spend across all 28 days in the window and all 45 days of the daily series provided. This is a leadgen client with no active paid pipeline. Sohib should confirm whether the pause is deliberate (e.g. budget hold, client request) or an inadvertent channel-dark situation. Success check: written confirmation from client or campaign reactivation by Sep 14.
